note: Cerebellar atrophy is consistently reported on brain MRI in RAB3A/SCA52 cases in OMIM and initial cohort reports, making its penetrance and utility as an invariant rule-out biomarker plausible to investigate.

evidence.text: Patients with monoallelic RAB3A variants presenting with cerebellar ataxia displayed cerebellar atrophy on brain MRI.

evidence.text: OMIM lists cerebellar atrophy on brain MRI as a primary clinical feature in SCA52 caused by heterozygous RAB3A mutations.

source.title: Entry - #621535 - SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52
source.quote: Features include gait and limb ataxia, nystagmus, and cerebellar atrophy, with variable dysarthria, dysphagia, and urinary urgency.
